app.name: Bumble
app.description: A dating and social networking app where women make the first move, offering modes for dating, friendship, and professional networking.

verdict.one_liner: Bumble collects sensitive personal data including your biometrics, tracks your behavior and conversations, and shares it with numerous vendors and advertisers.
verdict.summary: Bumble gathers identifiers like name, email, birth date, gender, location, photographs, and phone number. Optional details include height and faith. Social profile connections import additional data. Security checks capture phone numbers and, when opted in, facial geometry through biometric analysis by firms like Veriff. The platform also records geographic coordinates, hardware identifiers, billing details, engagement metrics, hyperlink usage, conversation themes, help desk tickets, and tracking technologies. Member profiles display this data to other users. Vendors including Twilio, Prove, Zendesk, Sierra, Cinder, Typeform, Kantar, Google Cloud, and OpenAI receive limited records for authentication, support, moderation, hosting, research, and AI features. Advertising partners obtain device signatures and behavior summaries. The organization releases material to satisfy legal demands, stop scams, uphold safety rules, facilitate ownership changes, and may furnish anonymized figures to observers. Users maintain various controls including access, amendment, removal, transfer, or limitation. European residents and some U.S. state residents have additional protections. Removing a profile triggers a roughly four-week grace period. Unused accounts for around four years also become eligible for clearance. Financial documentation archived for a decade. Proof of ejection kept 6-15 years. Help correspondences kept 6 years. Biometric images retained 36 months.
verdict.recommendation_reason: Bumble collects sensitive data including biometrics, tracks conversations and behavior, and shares with many vendors and advertisers. Data retention is excessive, with some information kept for up to 15 years.

red.title: Collects facial biometrics
red.plain_english: Bumble scans your face through a third-party company called Veriff to verify your identity, and keeps that biometric data for up to 3 years.

red.title: Tracks your conversations
red.plain_english: Bumble analyzes the themes and topics of your conversations with matches to improve the app and target ads.

red.title: Shares with many vendors
red.plain_english: Bumble shares your data with at least 10 different companies including Google Cloud, OpenAI, and Zendesk for various services.

red.title: Keeps data for years
red.plain_english: Even after you delete your account, Bumble keeps your financial records for 10 years, ejection proof for up to 15 years, and help chats for 6 years.

red.title: Shares with advertisers
red.plain_english: Bumble shares your device information and behavior with advertising partners to show you targeted ads.

green.title: User data rights available
green.plain_english: You can ask to see, fix, or delete your data. European and some U.S. users have extra legal protections.

green.title: Biometric verification is optional
green.plain_english: Face verification is not required. You only go through it if you choose to.
